llm.summary: The skill is not malware-like, but it can automatically save and revise project-planning files and hand work to other agent workflows without an explicit approval step.

dimensions.detail: Its stated purpose is project brainstorming, but the artifact also mandates war-room deliberation, a spec review loop, and automatic continuation into a specification skill; these are related to project planning but materially broader than simple ideation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad triggers such as planning and requirements, then instructs automatic downstream skill invocation and explicitly says not to prompt the user before continuing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown skill instructions and modules; no executable install scripts, hooks, credential requests, or static-scan findings were present, and VirusTotal telemetry was clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The file writes are scoped to project-planning artifacts such as docs/project-brief.md and optional deferred-capture behavior, but automatic subagent review and workflow chaining increase the amount of project context processed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs saving session state to .attune/brainstorm-session.json and allows the agent to edit planning/spec documents during review iterations without requiring user approval before each rewrite.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agentic planning workflow that can create and modify project-planning files, save local brainstorming state, dispatch review subagents, and continue into related skills by default. Use standalone or skip-review options where available if you want brainstorming output only, and review generated docs and .attune session files before committing or sharing them.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The artifact confirms automatic handoff to war-room and later specification workflow; this supports a Review verdict because the chaining is mandatory by default, even though it is related to producing a validated project brief.
[SDI-2] expected: The spec-review subagent is connected to document quality, but the artifact sends generated planning content into another agent and lets the main agent apply fixes automatically.
[SQP-1] expected: The listed triggers are relevant to brainstorming, but they are generic enough to invoke the skill in ordinary planning conversations where the user may not expect file persistence or workflow chaining.
[SQP-2] expected: Persisting brainstorm state is coherent with resumable planning, but the artifact does not make this opt-in or clearly warn that stakeholder, constraint, approach, and decision data will be saved locally.
[SQP-2] expected: Editing the generated spec or brief is related to the review loop, but the module gives the agent authority to apply fixes and retry before surfacing unresolved issues to the human.
[EA2] expected: Automatic continuation is part of the stated workflow, but the explicit no-confirmation instruction reduces user control after file creation.
[EA2] expected: The iterative review loop is bounded to three attempts, but it still permits repeated agent-directed changes to requirements or planning content before user review.
